extraction.Name: Phoebe Bordeaux (Mrs. Dave Whiting, deceased)
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded by R. E. Wang June 7, 1918
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to Peters Trust Company; land conveyed to John O. Petterson and Emma Petterson for $4000, subject to the mortgage which Petterson assumes and agrees to pay
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612449 issued December 21, 1917; receipt was signed by the allottee in February 1918; mortgage by Phoebe Whiting formerly Bordeaux and David Whiting dated May 10, 1918 for $1000 executed in favor of Peters Trust Company; deed dated February 26, 1920 by Phoebe Whiting formerly Bordeaux and husband conveyed land to John O. Petterson and Emma Petterson for $4000 subject to mortgage; Southwest quarter section 4, township 39, north of range 28
